name: Rubber Band Finger Extension
steps: Place a sturdy rubber band or therapeutic extensor band around the outside of all five fingertips and thumb.
Start with your fingertips and thumb pinched together in a closed cone position.
Slowly spread your fingers and thumb outward against the elastic resistance of the rubber band as wide as possible.
Hold for 1 to 2 seconds at the maximum open hand position, feeling the muscles on the back of your hand and forearm contract.
Slowly close your fingertips back together under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your wrist in a neutral straight position while opening your fingers.
Do not let the band snap your fingers closed; control the return phase.
This provides essential muscular balance against excessive gripping.
